description: Intent i009 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=io-uring-sq-ring) complete. Key structural fact: s02 is a pre-io_uring kernel — zero occurrences of io_uring/IORING_ across the entire 45,251-file tree (no fs/io_uring.c, no include/uapi/linux/io_uring.h), so the branch target is absent; the audit pivoted to the intent's adjacent mmap'd-ring plumbing under the seed's single-fetch (validated-equals-used) invariant. FINDING (medium confidence): net/packet/af_packet.c tpacket_snd() lines 2670-2685 — vnet_hdr points into the user-mmap'd TPACKET TX ring frame; __packet_snd_vnet_parse() (line 2416) validates vnet_hdr->hdr_len <= tp_len but does not cache it; line 2680 independently re-reads vnet_hdr->hdr_len from shared memory to compute copylen, which sizes sock_alloc_send_skb (line 2684) and the skb_put/skb_store_bits lengths in tpacket_fill_skb; line 2719 passes the same shared pointer to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb() for a third fetch of csum_start/csum_offset. Check-then-use double fetch on concurrently userspace-writable memory, same trust boundary as the seed's xsk_skb_metadata(). Counterevidence noted: u16 magnitude bound, tp_len already validated, and the csum re-fetch is re-validated by skb_partial_csum_set() against skb_headlen — impact is a hypothesis, not a proven OOB. All other ring consumers audited and classified safe with single-fetch evidence: fs/aio.c lookup_ioctx (get_user id once, line 1032), aio_read_events_ring (head/tail locals + %= nr_events, line 1165), refill_reqs_available (explicit clamp, line 940), io_submit_one (full copy_from_user snapshot, line 1783); kernel/events/ring_buffer.c perf_output_begin (READ_ONCE data_tail, line 161) and perf_aux_output_begin (READ_ONCE aux_tail, line 385); drivers/vhost/vhost.c vhost_get_vq_desc (ring_head fetched once and bounds-checked, per-iteration local desc copy, line 2035). Limitations: no io_uring present so dimension-4 SQE-field audit is vacuous for this tree; other mmap'd consumers (videobuf2, infiniband umem, xen gntdev, UIO) were identified but not deeply read.
